root: ^I think it’s about time I came clean.
^I’ve been here looking into who butchered the Sheriff's horse.
^Well, it was hard at first. First, we had Winston.
^An outlaw, someone who loves breaking the law, and has no respect for others' possessions.
^Then we had Lass Jessy, who hates it here obviously. She would love for this place to get shut down this season and head back home.
^And finally, we have you, Jesse, the son of the Sheriff. Pressured into his role as deputy, but all he wants to do is ride cows.
^What exactly are you getting to? Who are you saying did it?
^Jesse could never butcher his family horse, neither could you, Winston. You act all tough, but you’re just as law-abiding as everyone else. Which leaves Jessy.
^Who couldn’t have done it either. Since she has no idea how. Being she was raised in the city and all. That’s a mighty fine burger for a city slicker.
^No, it wasn’t any one of you.
^Is it not odd at all that you were apparently all at the village uphill, you all lost stuff, yet for some reason none of it was lost there?
^No, last night you all went out, butchered the horse, got your cover story together, and were sure the Sheriff wasn’t smart enough to figure it out.
^It was a great plan, but not great enough.
^Alright fine, you got us. We did it! None of us wanted to be here! That old man has to accept that the past is gone!
^So, are you going to tell him? Are you going to turn us in?
^Tell you what, Ill make you a drink. If you really do like it, and trust me Ill be able to tell, I won’t turn you in. If you don’t, well, looks like y'all are all in deep doo doo.
